reader.requirement: At 85 each sending item's characters are moved left to right into identifier-3 with no space fill: without SIZE until the sender ends, the receiver ends or the delimiter string is found (delimiter not moved; a partial match or a delimiter longer than the sender does not stop it), with SIZE the whole content until the receiver ends; repeated for every sender in order, a DELIMITED phrase governing the run of senders before it.

edition-consulted.switches: string-delimited-omitted-2002: refuses at 85 a trailing sender with no DELIMITED phrase

reader.edition-search: grep over StringEmitter.cs and CobolStringOps.cs: no edition reference; the back-propagation of DELIMITED in BindString is edition-blind.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: an omitted trailing DELIMITED is refused at 85 (implies SIZE at 2002+); the transfer itself is the same code
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf02_03 covers no-fill, delimiter stop, receiver-end stop, SIZE and sender order; not exercised: partial/longer delimiter, a DELIMITED phrase over a run of several senders, variable-length (ODO) sender or receiver, reference-modified senders at bounds, edited and signed numeric senders, later senders after the receiver is full
